card.name: Punctuation in scripture and manual references
card.fires_on: Punctuation or digits inside reference citations: the colon after a Revelation chapter number, and the dots and numbers in 'Section 3.7.6' style cross-references. It also fires on the period ending a 'See also:' list in Mathematica documentation.

modes.label: Bible verse colon
modes.description: The colon between chapter and verse after 'Rev. 19'.
modes.example: The three are cast into the lake of fire Rev. 19<<:>>20; Rev. 20

modes.example: See Section 1.8.3 and Section 3.<<7>>.6. Implementation Notes: see Section

modes.label: End of See also list
